preToolUse.bash: TOOL="${COPILOT_HOOK_TOOL_NAME:-}"; ARGS="${COPILOT_HOOK_TOOL_ARGS:-}"; if echo "$ARGS" | grep -qE '(rm -rf /|rm -rf \*|rm -rf ~|rm -rf \.)'; then echo '{"decision": "deny", "reason": "SECURITY: Dangerous recursive deletion blocked by security hook."}'; elif echo "$ARGS" | grep -qE 'git push --force'; then echo '{"decision": "deny", "reason": "SECURITY: Force push is not allowed. Use regular git push."}'; elif echo "$ARGS" | grep -qE 'git push.*--force-with-lease'; then echo '{"decision": "deny", "reason": "SECURITY: Force push with lease is also not allowed."}'; elif echo "$ARGS" | grep -qE 'curl.*\| *(sh|bash)'; then echo '{"decision": "deny", "reason": "SECURITY: Piping remote content to shell is not allowed."}'; elif echo "$ARGS" | grep -qE 'wget.*\| *(sh|bash)'; then echo '{"decision": "deny", "reason": "SECURITY: Piping remote content to shell is not allowed."}'; elif echo "$ARGS" | grep -qE 'npm run (deploy|upload)'; then echo '{"decision": "deny", "reason": "SECURITY: Production deployment requires explicit user approval. Cannot run autonomously."}'; elif echo "$TOOL" | grep -q 'write' && echo "$ARGS" | grep -qiE '(password|secret|api_key|token|private_key)\s*[:=]\s*["'\''a-zA-Z0-9]'; then echo '{"decision": "deny", "reason": "SECURITY: Potential credential exposure detected. Do not write secrets to files."}'; elif echo "$TOOL" | grep -q 'write' && echo "$ARGS" | grep -qE 'infra/secrets/'; then echo '{"decision": "deny", "reason": "SECURITY: Writing to infra/secrets/ requires explicit user approval."}'; elif echo "$TOOL" | grep -q 'write' && echo "$ARGS" | grep -qE '\.github/workflows/'; then echo '{"decision": "ask", "reason": "Modifying CI/CD workflows requires review. Please confirm."}'; else echo '{"decision": "allow"}'; fi

permissionRequest.bash: TOOL="${COPILOT_HOOK_TOOL_NAME:-}"; if echo "$TOOL" | grep -qE '(deploy|upload|force)'; then echo '{"behavior": "deny"}'; else echo '{}'; fi
